description: Objects the schema no longer has. Columns: the migrations remove them after moving their data; an implementation that only validates (and does not migrate) must refuse a database that still has one, since older SDK versions are using it. Indexes: dropped (DROP INDEX IF EXISTS) after the concurrent indexes are built; until then they only cost writes, so a validating implementation may tolerate them. Indexes a concurrent index replaces are retired too, and listed there.

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_completed_non_cron
indexes.doc: No query could use it: none filters on metadata source.

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_dead_letter
indexes.doc: Dead-lettered roots are found through idx_runnerq_root_terminal; listing reads idx_runnerq_query_status.

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_root_only
indexes.doc: Roots lists filter by depth across queues; nothing used it.

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_query_type_created
indexes.doc: Type filters read idx_runnerq_query_created; one more entry on every status change wasn't worth it.

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_dependencies_producer
indexes.doc: A producer is always the result's own activity, so deleting a tree reads idx_runnerq_dependencies_result.
